blocks.text: Selfcare Now is a white-label website where customers sign up and pay, and get help when they need it. It connects to Alepo CRM and the AI Customer Assistant. A mobile app is in beta.

Self-care at many operators is dated, and slow sign-up and payment flows push customers to the call center and make the operator look behind its competitors. Selfcare Now turns those visits into completed tasks.

head: Fact
Detail
rows: Alepo CRM and billing, plus online charging. Payment gateways. The AI Customer Assistant.
In your environment, on Kubernetes, with 24x7 support

blocks.text: Also known as: self-care portal, web self-care, **customer portal software**, My Account, eCare, digital onboarding

sections.h2: Your brand in more than 30 languages

blocks.text: A white-label website in more than 30 languages, including right-to-left.
Customers pay by card, set up auto-pay and get payment reminders.
Sign-up and payment are short, so fewer customers end up in the call center.
Your flows are tailored to how you work and connected to Alepo CRM.
The AI Customer Assistant answers inside the same pages.

The AI Customer Assistant is built in. It answers routine questions around the clock and completes account tasks inside the signed-in customer's own account. Complex cases go to a care agent, and offers such as a travel-data pass can appear inside the conversation.
See how AI works across Alepo products →

items.a: **Self-service portal software** lets customers manage their own accounts online: sign up, pay bills, change plans and solve common problems without calling.

items.q: Is there a mobile app as well?
items.a: Yes, in beta. The Selfcare Now app offers the same tasks, and is not yet published in the app stores.

blocks.text: Your team installs Selfcare Now in containers, one standard way, like every Alepo product. When something needs fixing, the patch goes only to the component affected, with rollback ready. It runs in your environment, with 24x7 support from GTAC.
